verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs show CLI sync/pull for pricing config (autumn.config.ts) and webhooks for event data, but there is no documented feature for exporting all customer/usage/billing data in an open format to allow a user or team to leave the platform. missing for 10: a documented full data-export or account-portability feature, open-format bulk export of customer/usage records, evidence of data portability upon offboarding.
